source.name: Crédit Agricole Italia press release, 'Al via la partnership tra Crédit Agricole Italia e Parma Calcio'
source.quote: la Banca diventa per i prossimi tre anni Sleeve Sponsor della squadra gialloblu
source.note: 'The Bank becomes sleeve sponsor of the team for the next three years' (Italian): a three-year term from September 2024, running through 2026/27. Value not disclosed.
